environment.description: Deployment target environment. PROD is gated.

service.description: Service slug to deploy (e.g. jellyfin). Not restricted; baseline example is jellyfin.

confirm.description: Required for PROD apply. Must exactly match the workflow’s expected confirmation string.

hostname.description: Optional override for the LXC hostname (default derived from service).

vmid.description: Optional explicit VMID. Must not collide with existing containers.

gpu_passthrough_enabled.description: Whether GPU passthrough should be enabled (disabled by default).
